The newly incorporated balance control technology ensures microgram-level baseline stability and reproducibility on top of Hitachi’s acclaimed horizontal digital dual beam balance system. Multiple furnace options and furnace control technology that handles every application
Modulated DSC
RealView® sample image capture
Optimized flow channel for precise purge gas control/exchange

 Details 
NEXTA STA series, Hitachi’s latest series simultaneous DSC/TGA (STA), delivers superior performance along with exceptional build quality and the most robust robotic autosampler on the market. The newly incorporated balance control technology ensures microgram-level baseline stability and reproducibility on top of Hitachi’s acclaimed horizontal digital dual beam balance system. The NEXTA STA series has the following features; 
Multiple furnace options and furnace control technology that handles every application 
Modulated DSC 
RealView® sample image capture 
Optimized flow channel for precise purge gas control/exchange 
In addition to conventional applications, the NEXTA STA series shows its strength in analyses such as quantitative determination of the constituents of advanced materials, composite materials, and trace amounts of moisture.
 Features and Benefits 
World class baseline performance 
The NEXTA STA new balance control builds upon the popular dual beam system from prior generations. The NEXTA STA series achieved baseline stability that is virtually unaffected by the temperature program. 
Flexibility to meet your demanding applications 
Available in two temperature ranges with a variety of different furnace types and purge flow control configurations 
Available DSC measurement on the NEXTA STA series - Specific heat capacity measurement over the wide temperature range achieved by DSC 
The NEXTA STA series showcases an evolution from DTA to DSC, enabling simultaneous thermogravimetry and DSC measurement, a significant improvement over prior generations. In addition, by using temperature modulated DSC, specific heat capacity measurements are achieved over a wide temperature range that cannot be measured by (the) standalone DSC. 
“Real View®” Sample Observation Option 
The well-received “Real View®” option has been further developed. 
 Not only are samples observed while measurements are in progress, but various analysis features have been incorporated, such as digital zoom, image analysis, length measurement capability, and color analysis, which can support a variety of applications. 
*“Real View” is a registered trademark of Hitachi High-Tech Science Corporation in the U.S, Brazil, China, India, Turkey, the European Union, and Japan.
